domain_label: Classic-Luxurious Genre Bible — Scenario & Location Bank (quiet-luxury scene concepts, famous-location library, per-persona staging, seasonal/time-of-day calendar logic)
purpose: A method for the units of expert work a scenario/location specialist reasons about when staging the two-persona classic-luxurious feed: locking the quiet-luxury visual register, cataloging each famous-luxury-location's sourced visual signature and season/light window, building the ~32-concept scene bank (mood | props | light) across morning-ritual, craft/tailoring, motion/travel, culture/taste, table/evening and fitness-accent blocks, setting per-persona and duo staging rules, and composing the seasonal-location-wheel plus time-of-day grammar into a weekly content-calendar cadence — every claim carried at the honesty level the grounding research file assigned it (FACT, FACT-lite, ESTIMATE with basis/confidence, or a named UNKNOWN blocker), never inventing a location detail, statistic, or legal clearance the research did not supply.
assumptions: no live analytics or a/b performance data is supplied; every scene-cadence and weekly-rhythm number is an explicit ESTIMATE editorial starting point flagged for later analytics tuning, not a measured result

all location geography is FACT-lite (public, uncontroversial) unless the research file cites a specific source for the visual-distinctness claim, in which case that claim is carried as FACT with its source
the 32-scene bank itself is craft synthesis (ESTIMATE) conforming to the sourced material/color/light codes; the scenes are not independently sourced claims and must never be cited as if they were

whether specific named hotels/villas/brands can be referenced without trademark risk is an open question the research file marks UNKNOWN and defers to a separate likeness/rights file; this KB only authors the generic, unbranded archetype descriptions it confirmed are the safer lane
the likeness closed-lane (evoking a specific real person while hiding the face) is out of scope everywhere in this KB and is never given staging guidance
exclusions: the likeness/rights legal boundary on named properties, brands and trademarked trade dress (car grilles, mascots, hotel names) — that determination belongs to the likeness/rights research file, cross-referenced but not resolved here

the AI-artifact taxonomy proper (waxy skin, marble-vein repeats, warped type) beyond the luxury-specific intersections named for handoff — the full taxonomy lives in the realism/QC specialist's own KB
prompt syntax, model/parameter selection, camera-move vocabulary and other Higgsfield-surface specifics — those belong to the prompting/cine specialists, not the scenario/location bank
wardrobe construction detail and per-garment sourcing beyond the accessory/prop styling rules needed to keep scenes in-register
engagement statistics, platform algorithm behavior or audience psychology findings — none are in the grounding file for this KB and none are invented here

competency_questions.question: What is the classic-luxurious genre lock, and what register must every location, scene and prop decision be tested against?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: GENRE_LOCK_REGISTER states classic-luxurious = quiet-luxury visual grammar + cinematic execution, cites the Kapferer identity-over-features backbone, and states loud-luxury markers are out of genre except as rare, gated contrast beats

competency_questions.acceptance_condition: LOCATION_AMALFI gives the cliffside/majolica/whitewash signature and summer window, and LOCATION_COMO gives the neoclassical-villa/cypress/Riva-launch signature and late-spring-to-early-autumn window

competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SCENARIO_LUXURY_BREAK_TELLS enumerates the gauche-tell checklist, marks each item FACT or ESTIMATE per the research file, and hands the AI-artifact intersection to the realism/QC specialist by cross-reference rather than reproducing its full taxonomy

glossary.definition: A recognized aesthetic (synonyms: stealth wealth, old-money aesthetic, silent luxury) defined by understated design, high-quality materials, timeless styling, muted colors, craftsmanship, and deliberate avoidance of logos/flashy status markers; popularized via HBO's Succession and the 2023 TikTok old-money surge [FACT - Wikipedia "Quiet luxury"; Hypebeast; Fortune].

The contrasting register: vibrant palettes, eye-catching patterns, prominently displayed branding, and statement pieces designed to be the centerpiece [FACT - baltini quiet-vs-loud guide]; kept out of genre except as rare, gated contrast beats.

The operating definition every specialist obeys: classic-luxurious = quiet-luxury visual grammar + cinematic execution, adopted as a durable visual grammar rather than a trend label [ESTIMATE - medium-high confidence, basis old-money aesthetic's decades-long persistence].

The Japanese aesthetic principle that the patina of age is the highest beauty, sourced from the Kyoto ryokan register [FACT - insidekyoto Tawaraya feature] and generalized across the bank as the patina-over-pristine staging principle.

The fixed authoring format for every entry in the 32-scene bank: a one-line mood, a short prop list, and a light description; the format itself and each concept's specific composition are craft synthesis (ESTIMATE), not sourced claims.

A generic, unbranded scene-location description (e.g. "private-jet interior," "classic yacht") used in place of a specific trademarked property or model name, adopted as the safer default while the likeness/rights file's clearance question stays UNKNOWN.

The time-of-day light vocabulary the bank schedules scene types against: golden hour (low warm side or back light, morning or evening) for drives/terraces/arrivals, and blue hour (deep navy sky plus warm practicals) for penthouse/harbor/table-anticipation beats [ESTIMATE - high confidence, basis the sourced §2 palette codes plus standard cinematography convention].

The editorial rule that fitness-accent scenes appear roughly 1 in 5-7 posts, always in the feed's shared palette/light grammar, an estimate the owner specified only as "sometimes" [ESTIMATE - medium].

The staging rule that the M and F personas alternate scene TYPES (his craft beat, her culture beat) while sharing palette, in-season locations and light grammar, reserving joint MF scenes for evening/travel beats [ESTIMATE - medium-high].

source_registry.description: heuristic prior estimates for luxury_scenario_location_bank work units in absence of supplied datasets
source_registry.citation_or_locator: heuristic prior; no external dataset supplied

nodes.definition: Lock the classic-luxurious genre to the quiet-luxury visual register before any location or scene work begins. Quiet luxury (stealth wealth, old-money aesthetic, silent luxury) is a recognized aesthetic defined by understated design, high-quality materials, timeless styling, muted colors, craftsmanship, and deliberate avoidance of logos/flashy status markers [FACT - Wikipedia "Quiet luxury"]. It was mass-popularized by HBO's Succession's unbranded-but-expensive costuming and the 2023 TikTok old-money/stealth-wealth surge [FACT - Hypebeast; Fortune]. The theoretical backbone is Kapferer & Bastien's The Luxury Strategy: luxury communicates identity and heritage, not features, and inverts normal marketing (scarcity over reach, no discounting) [FACT - Kapferer & Bastien, The Luxury Strategy]. Fashion press called peak quiet-luxury trend-fatigued by Jan 2024 as runway styles regained flair [FACT]; the operation reads quiet luxury as a durable visual grammar outlasting that label, not a trend to chase [ESTIMATE - medium-high, basis old-money aesthetic's decades-long persistence]. Loud-luxury elements (logo walls, hypercar flash, champagne-spray, cash/watch-flex poses) are OUT of genre except as deliberate, rare, calendar-gated contrast beats.

included: the quiet-vs-loud luxury register definition
the Kapferer identity-over-features backbone
the genre-lock-not-trend-chasing framing
rare gated contrast beats as the only loud-luxury allowance
excluded: per-location, per-car and per-scene specifics (their own nodes)
styling/prop rules (their own node)
the AI-artifact QC taxonomy (realism specialist's file)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: quiet-luxury press redefines the aesthetic or a contrast-beat policy changes

pros.claim: Locking classic-luxurious to quiet-luxury grammar gives every downstream location, scene and prop decision one consistent yardstick
pros.example: rejecting a logo-forward handbag shot on the same test that accepts an unbranded cashmere-blazer shot

cons.claim: Treating quiet luxury as timeless risks looking dated if the trend-fatigue press call proves more than cyclical
cons.example: leaning entirely on 2023-era muted-beige styling after the aesthetic itself visibly shifts register

failure_modes: applying loud-luxury markers (logos, hypercar flash, champagne-spray) as if they were in-genre
chasing the TikTok trend cycle instead of the underlying old-money grammar
treating luxury content as a product pitch instead of a world
acceptance_tests: the analysis states the quiet-vs-loud definition, cites the Kapferer identity-over-features principle, and states loud-luxury markers are out of genre except as rare, calendar-gated contrast beats
revisit_triggers: quiet-luxury press coverage shifts the aesthetic's definition materially
a rare loud-luxury contrast beat is proposed and needs a go/no-go
a new specialist (prompting/lighting/wardrobe/QC) needs the genre lock restated

nodes.definition: Catalog the Amalfi Coast / Positano signature: dramatic cliffside vertical villages, pastel stacked buildings (yellows, terracotta, whitewash), lemon groves, hand-painted majolica tile, and wrought-iron balconies with arched windows over saturated blue sea [FACT - designeersclub Amalfi guide; isclatravel architectural-features]. Season/light: summer core (May-Sep); hard Mediterranean noon plus long golden-hour evening is the signature slot [FACT-lite]. In the morning-ritual scene block this is the espresso-on-terrace anchor (white demitasse, linen shirt, folded newspaper, low warm side sun) [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis conforming to the sourced material/palette codes].

included: the cliffside/pastel/majolica/wrought-iron signature
the summer season and hard-noon/golden-evening light window
the espresso-terrace scene anchor
excluded: named-hotel specificity (deferred to the likeness/rights file)
the seasonal wheel's cross-location pairing logic (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: new sourced architectural/material detail on Amalfi surfaces or the seasonal window is revised

pros.claim: Amalfi's cliffside/majolica/whitewash signature is instantly recognizable without needing a branded landmark
pros.example: a terrace-espresso frame reading unmistakably Amalfi from tile, whitewash and cliff geometry alone

cons.claim: Amalfi is a hard summer-only location, so overusing it out of season breaks the calendar's seasonal-accuracy rule
cons.example: scheduling an Amalfi terrace beat in January when the location reads unmistakably as a summer destination

failure_modes: shooting Amalfi in a snow/winter context
substituting generic Mediterranean whitewash for the majolica-tile and wrought-iron specifics that make it legible as Amalfi

nodes.definition: Catalog the Lake Como signature: neoclassical villas and formal gardens on a deep alpine lake, cypress trees, stone boat docks, and wooden Riva-style launches [FACT-lite - publicly documented geography and villa architecture]. Season/light: late spring through early autumn is the operative window; soft hazy mornings are the signature light [FACT-lite]. In the scenario bank Como anchors both a morning-balcony beat (silk robe, crystal glass, cypress view, hazy morning bounce) and the wooden-launch motion beat (varnished mahogany, wake spray, golden hour, long lens) [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis conforming to the sourced signature].

included: the villa/cypress/Riva-launch signature
the late-spring-to-early-autumn window and hazy-morning light
the balcony and launch scene anchors
excluded: named-villa specificity (deferred to the likeness/rights file)
the yacht archetype it is compared against for the launch-vs-superyacht texture (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new sourced Como architectural detail surfaces or the season window is revised

pros.claim: Como's Riva-launch/cypress signature gives a distinct still-water register from the coastal-cliff Amalfi look
pros.example: a wake-spray launch shot reading as Como rather than a generic lakeside anywhere

cons.claim: The neoclassical-villa signature is generic enough to be confused with other alpine lakes without the cypress/Riva-launch specifics in frame
cons.example: a lake-house shot with no cypress trees or launch reading as an unnamed alpine lake rather than Como

failure_modes: dropping the cypress/Riva-launch specifics and shooting a generic lakeside instead
scheduling Como outside its late-spring-to-early-autumn window

nodes.definition: Catalog the Monaco/Monte Carlo signature: Belle Époque casino architecture, a superyacht-packed Port Hercule, tight corniche roads above the Mediterranean, and a manicured formality that reads year-round [FACT-lite]. Light: sharp daytime sun and a blue-hour harbor-lights slot that is the location's signature evening register [FACT-lite]. In the scenario bank Monaco anchors the corniche night-arrival beat (evening wear, harbor bokeh, blue hour plus warm practicals) [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis]. Monaco carries real loud-luxury risk (superyacht/casino flash) alongside its quiet-compatible corniche-and-blue-hour register; the operation defaults to the latter [ESTIMATE - high confidence, basis the genre-lock register].

included: the Belle Époque/Port Hercule/corniche signature
the sharp-day/blue-hour light window
the loud-luxury risk and the quiet-compatible corniche default
excluded: the casino/superyacht flash register itself (excluded as loud-luxury by the genre lock)
the yacht archetype docked there (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a Monaco imagery drift toward casino/marina flash is observed, or the blue-hour register is refined

pros.claim: Monaco's corniche-and-blue-hour register gives an occasion beat with real narrative weight without leaning on casino/superyacht flash
pros.example: a blue-hour valet-arrival shot reading as occasion and restraint rather than casino spectacle

cons.claim: Monaco's default public imagery (superyacht marina, casino) is genuinely loud-luxury, so an unguided shoot easily drifts out of register
cons.example: a Port Hercule establishing shot reading as superyacht-flex rather than the intended restrained corniche beat

failure_modes: defaulting to casino/marina flash imagery instead of the corniche-and-blue-hour register
shooting Monaco in flat midday light and losing its signature blue-hour quality

nodes.definition: Catalog the St. Moritz signature: alpine grand-hotel glamour, a frozen lake carrying a winter polo/horse-racing tradition, pine slopes, and champagne-snow light [FACT-lite]. Season: winter core (Dec-Mar); low golden winter sun and blue snow shadows are the signature light [FACT-lite]. In the scenario bank it anchors the fireplace-nightcap evening beat (cashmere throw, embers, fire as key light, window blue fill) [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis].

included: the alpine grand-hotel/frozen-lake/pine signature
the winter-core season and champagne-snow light
the fireplace-nightcap scene anchor
excluded: the Aspen winter register it is compared against for texture (its own node)
the table/evening block's other non-St.-Moritz entries (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new sourced St. Moritz detail surfaces or the winter window is revised

pros.claim: St. Moritz's frozen-lake and champagne-snow light give a winter register distinct from Aspen's Bauhaus-modernist take
pros.example: a fireplace-nightcap shot reading as European alpine grandeur rather than American ski-town modernism

cons.claim: A snowless St. Moritz shot outside its winter core immediately reads as an out-of-season error
cons.example: a bare-slope St. Moritz exterior shot in August breaking the location's signature identity

failure_modes: shooting St. Moritz without snow/winter light and losing its signature identity
conflating St. Moritz's European grand-hotel register with Aspen's Victorian-plus-modernist one

nodes.definition: Catalog the Dubai signature and its risk: modern supertall skyline, desert dunes adjacent to glass towers, and a marina-at-night register [FACT-lite]. Season: winter (Nov-Mar) is the workable exterior window; dusk/night is the signature slot [FACT-lite]. Genre caution: Dubai's default public imagery reads as loud luxury (skyline flash, marina spectacle), so the operation restricts it to desert-at-dusk exteriors, old-town textures, and quiet penthouse interiors rather than skyline/marina flex framing [ESTIMATE - high confidence, basis the quiet-vs-loud register in the genre lock]. This is the single location in the bank where the default imagery most directly conflicts with the genre lock, making its safe-treatment rule high-stakes.

included: the skyline/desert/marina signature and its default loud-luxury read
the winter exterior window and dusk/night light
the desert-dusk/old-town/penthouse safe-treatment restriction
excluded: the penthouse archetype itself (its own node)
named-tower or named-hotel specificity (deferred to the likeness/rights file)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: Dubai imagery is shot leaning on skyline/marina flash, or the safe-treatment restriction is loosened or tightened

pros.claim: Restricting Dubai to desert-dusk, old-town and quiet-penthouse registers lets the location contribute to the bank without breaking the genre lock
pros.example: a desert-at-dusk exterior beat reading as quiet luxury rather than the location's default skyline-flex imagery

cons.claim: The restriction discards most of Dubai's most recognizable imagery (supertall skyline, marina), so the location may read as generically desert rather than specifically Dubai
cons.example: a desert-dusk shot with no skyline cue at all being mistaken for a different desert location entirely

failure_modes: defaulting to skyline/marina flex framing because it is Dubai's most available stock imagery
shooting Dubai exteriors outside the Nov-Mar workable window
acceptance_tests: the analysis states the skyline/marina default reads loud, and restricts Dubai content to desert-at-dusk exteriors, old-town textures and quiet penthouse interiors
revisit_triggers: a Dubai shoot is proposed that leans on skyline/marina imagery and needs a go/no-go against the restriction
the likeness/rights file rules on named-tower depiction

nodes.definition: Catalog the Maldives overwater-villa signature: sloping roofs, woven panels, natural timbers fused with modern geometry, floor-to-ceiling glazing over a turquoise lagoon, glass floor panels, terrazzo surfaces and oceanic-hue linens [FACT - hoteldesigns.net overwater-villa design-language feature]. the dry-season window and sunrise/sunset light
excluded: named-resort specificity (deferred to the likeness/rights file)
the yacht/jet archetypes it is combined with in travel scenes (their own nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new sourced overwater-villa material detail surfaces or the dry-season window is revised

pros.claim: The overwater-villa timber-and-glazing signature reads as luxury without leaning on any branded or loud element
pros.example: a glass-floor-panel shot over a lagoon reading as high-end craft rather than flashy display

cons.claim: Shooting the Maldives outside its Dec-Apr dry-season window risks storm-grey skies that break the sourced sunrise/sunset light signature
cons.example: a monsoon-season Maldives shot losing the turquoise-lagoon color the register depends on

nodes.definition: Catalog the Aspen signature: mining-town Victorian heritage layered with Bauhaus/International-style modernism (geometric simplicity, large glass onto mountain views), with contemporary hotels mixing in Scandinavian/Japanese minimalism [FACT - avantgardeaspen architectural-tapestry guide]. Season: winter ski season plus golden aspen-leaf autumn; crisp high-altitude light is the signature quality [FACT-lite].

included: the Victorian-plus-Bauhaus/modernist signature
the winter-ski and golden-autumn windows and crisp high-altitude light
excluded: the St. Moritz alpine-winter register it is contrasted against (its own node)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new sourced Aspen architectural detail surfaces or the season windows are revised

pros.claim: Aspen's Victorian-plus-modernist mix gives a distinctly American ski-luxury register apart from St. Moritz's European grand-hotel look
pros.example: a big-glass mountain-view interior shot reading as Aspen-modernist rather than alpine-European

cons.claim: Conflating Aspen's two heritage layers (Victorian mining-town vs Bauhaus modernism) without picking one for a given shot can read as visually inconsistent
cons.example: mixing an ornate Victorian facade with a stark modernist interior in the same beat without a clear transition

failure_modes: shooting Aspen outside its winter-or-golden-autumn windows
blending the Victorian and modernist registers within a single frame without intent

nodes.definition: Catalog the Kyoto ryokan-class signature: tatami floors, shoji/fusuma paper screens, a tokonoma alcove with a hanging scroll, hinoki-cypress baths, and sukiya tea-room architecture, with wabi-sabi (the patina of age) as the register's highest beauty [FACT - insidekyoto Tawaraya ryokan feature]. Season: spring sakura and autumn momiji are the signature windows; diffuse paper-screen light is the signature quality [FACT-lite]. This is the source of the operation's general patina-over-pristine principle, generalized to every other location and prop in the bank [ESTIMATE - high, generalization basis stated explicitly].

included: the tatami/shoji/tokonoma/hinoki signature
the sakura/momiji windows and diffuse paper-screen light
the wabi-sabi patina-over-pristine principle and its generalization
excluded: the culture/taste scene block's non-Kyoto entries (its own node)
named-ryokan specificity (deferred to the likeness/rights file)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a new sourced ryokan detail surfaces or the patina-generalization is challenged by a location-specific weathering cue

pros.claim: Sourcing the patina-over-pristine principle from a named register grounds an otherwise-estimated bank-wide styling rule in a specific source
pros.example: citing the ryokan wabi-sabi source when justifying why a craft-tailoring prop should show wear rather than looking showroom-new

cons.claim: Generalizing a Japanese-specific aesthetic principle to every other location risks flattening each location's own distinct patina register
cons.example: applying wabi-sabi vocabulary literally to an Amalfi terrace shot instead of that location's own weathering cues (sun-bleached whitewash, worn wrought iron)

failure_modes: shooting the ryokan with showroom-new tatami/props and zero patina
scheduling Kyoto content outside the sakura/momiji windows

nodes.definition: Define the private-jet interior archetype (generic, not a named aircraft model): cream leather club seats, walnut veneer tables, oval windows admitting cloud light; the small cabin forces intimate framing [FACT-lite, generic archetype]. Light: any time of day, with window key-light at altitude as the signature quality [FACT-lite]. In the scenario bank it anchors both the boarding-steps arrival beat (leather holdall, tarmac wind) and the in-cabin espresso/contract beat (fountain pen, single-source window key) [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis].

included: the cream-leather/walnut/oval-window signature

the boarding and in-cabin scene anchors

the yacht/penthouse archetypes it is grouped with (their own nodes)

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a named-aircraft trademark clearance is resolved or a new cabin material detail surfaces

pros.claim: Keeping the jet interior a generic archetype avoids any specific-aircraft trademark question while still reading unmistakably as private aviation
pros.example: cream leather, walnut veneer and an oval window reading as private-jet luxury with no visible manufacturer branding

nodes.definition: Define the classic yacht/superyacht archetype: teak decks, white hull, brass fittings, navy cushions; sailing classics are read as older-money than plastic-white modern motoryachts [FACT-lite base signature; the older-money-read claim is ESTIMATE - medium-high confidence, basis the quiet-luxury register]. In the scenario bank it anchors the rope-coiling/helm-hands competence beat and the wooden Riva-style launch glide beat shared with Lake Como [ESTIMATE - craft synthesis].

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: a sourced finding on yacht-type luxury perception surfaces, replacing the current estimate

conflict_axes.name: quiet_grammar_vs_locations_native_loud_register

conflict_axes.description: Showroom-new props and sets read as staged while wabi-sabi patina reads as owned, a principle sourced from the Kyoto ryokan register and generalized across the bank.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: prefer patina except on objects where active maintenance is itself the luxury signal (polished brightwork on a classic yacht)

poles: reserved joint staging plus solo-persona alternation
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: alternate solo scene TYPES between M and F, and reserve joint MF scenes for evening/travel beats only

conflict_axes.name: hard_midday_light_vs_controlled_soft_light_default
conflict_axes.description: Hard direct midday light is a named cheap-light tell, but certain sourced locations (Amalfi whitewash, yacht decks, snow) legitimately carry and even require it.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: default to the soft/golden/blue-hour grammar everywhere except the specific locations sourced as carrying hard midday light

conflict_axes.name: rare_contrast_beat_vs_genre_drift
conflict_axes.description: An occasional loud-luxury contrast beat (a modern hypercar, a Monaco-night flash shot) can be justified for variety, but repetition risks the 'rare' exception drifting into a routine practice that erodes the genre lock.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: gate any contrast beat through the weekly calendar cadence and cap its frequency explicitly rather than allowing ad hoc repetition

conflict_axes.name: craft_synthesis_estimate_vs_sourced_fact_in_scene_concepts
conflict_axes.description: The ~32-concept scene bank is craft synthesis (ESTIMATE) conforming to sourced material/location codes, but it is easy to present a specific scene composition as if it were itself independently sourced fact.
poles: treating scene concepts as sourced fact
carrying the craft-synthesis/ESTIMATE label on every concept
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: always distinguish the sourced material/location codes (FACT) underneath a scene from the scene composition itself (ESTIMATE)

edge_cases.description: A St. Moritz snow scene is scheduled in July when the location has no snow
edge_cases.trigger: calendar/shoot convenience overrides the seasonal wheel's Dec-Mar placement
edge_cases.mitigation: enforce the never-out-of-season rule and substitute an in-season location from the wheel before scheduling

edge_cases.description: Dubai content is shot as mall-glitz or skyline-flex framing instead of the locked desert-dusk/penthouse treatment
edge_cases.trigger: the location's most available stock imagery is its default loud register
edge_cases.mitigation: restrict Dubai beats to desert-at-dusk exteriors, old-town textures and quiet penthouse interiors per the safe-treatment rule

edge_cases.description: A scene concept's caption names a specific real hotel or villa to make the location more legible
edge_cases.trigger: a scene needs a landmark punch and reaches for a trademarked property name
edge_cases.mitigation: use the generic archetype description only, and defer any named-property clearance to the likeness/rights file's still-open determination

edge_cases.description: A fitness-accent scene drifts into neon-compression, branded-gym-tank or oiled-flex-pose styling
edge_cases.trigger: physique-forward framing is chosen over the heritage-sport capability-and-grace rule
edge_cases.mitigation: restrict fitness styling to the sourced old-money sport canon's heritage athletic wear and capability-in-motion framing

edge_cases.description: A gallery, auction or table-setting prop list defaults to a visibly branded label or logo
edge_cases.trigger: an available prop happens to carry visible branding and is used as-is
edge_cases.mitigation: swap for the unbranded/plain equivalent per the material and branding codes before the prop enters frame

edge_cases.description: The weekly calendar posts two motion/travel beats back-to-back with no ritual/detail beat between them
edge_cases.trigger: the weekly rhythm's beat-count guidance is not followed when scheduling
edge_cases.mitigation: hold the suggested weekly rhythm (1 place-establishing, 2-3 ritual/detail, 1 motion, 1 evening, fitness roughly every 1.5 weeks) as the editorial starting point, retuned by analytics feedback

edge_cases.description: A joint MF persona scene is used for a routine morning-ritual beat instead of being reserved for evening/travel
edge_cases.trigger: joint framing is chosen for a beat outside its reserved slot
edge_cases.mitigation: reserve joint MF scenes for evening/travel beats and keep morning/craft beats on the solo-persona alternation rule

edge_cases.description: A Kyoto ryokan scene is shot with showroom-new tatami and zero patina
edge_cases.trigger: the patina-over-pristine rule is not applied to newly sourced or rented props
edge_cases.mitigation: apply the wabi-sabi patina-as-beauty principle sourced from the ryokan register before the scene is shot

edge_cases.description: A yacht scene uses a plastic-white modern motoryacht instead of a classic teak/brass sailing vessel because it was the more available charter asset
edge_cases.trigger: vessel selection defaults to whichever charter is on hand rather than the sourced sailing-classic archetype
edge_cases.mitigation: prefer the sailing-classic teak/brass staging the archetype specifies, flagging the older-money read as an estimate not a settled claim

edge_cases.description: A scene concept from the ~32-entry bank is cited to a stakeholder as verified/sourced fact rather than craft synthesis
edge_cases.trigger: the ESTIMATE tag on the scenario bank is dropped in downstream communication
edge_cases.mitigation: always carry the craft-synthesis/ESTIMATE label when presenting scene concepts, distinguishing them from the sourced material/location codes underneath

edge_cases.description: A private-jet or penthouse beat is captioned in a way that implies endorsement by a specific aircraft, watch or building brand
edge_cases.trigger: caption copy names a brand without rights clearance
edge_cases.mitigation: de-emphasize or blur badges/brand cues and avoid brand names in captions implying endorsement, per the trademark-caution default posture

workflow.action: Lock the quiet-luxury register before any location or scene work begins
workflow.description: State the quiet-vs-loud definition, the Kapferer identity-over-features backbone, and the rare-gated-contrast-beat allowance
workflow.gate: the quiet/loud contrast and the out-of-genre loud markers are stated

workflow.action: Catalog the Mediterranean/alpine core location signatures
workflow.description: Fix Amalfi, Como, Monaco and St. Moritz visual signatures and light/season windows
workflow.gate: each location's distinct materials/architecture and season/light window are stated

workflow.action: Flag the Dubai loud-luxury risk and lock its safe treatment
workflow.description: State the skyline/marina default-loud read and the desert-dusk/old-town/penthouse restriction
workflow.gate: the default-loud risk and the safe-treatment restriction are stated

workflow.action: Catalog the Maldives, Aspen and Kyoto ryokan signatures
workflow.description: Fix the overwater-villa, Victorian/modernist and ryokan signatures and their season windows
workflow.gate: each location's material/architecture signature and season window are stated

workflow.action: Define the private-jet, yacht and penthouse interior archetypes
workflow.description: Fix each generic archetype's material and light signature and its scene anchors
workflow.gate: the three archetypes' material and light signatures are stated

workflow.action: Build the morning-ritual and craft/tailoring scene blocks
workflow.description: Author both blocks' scene concepts in mood|props|light form tied to sourced locations/archetypes
workflow.gate: each scene gives mood, props and light per the ESTIMATE-tagged bank format

workflow.action: Build the motion/travel, culture/taste and table/evening scene blocks
workflow.description: Author the remaining three blocks' scene concepts tied to sourced locations/archetypes
workflow.gate: each block's scenes give mood/props/light and cite the archetype/location they draw from

workflow.action: Integrate fitness-accent scenes and lock the capability-over-flex framing
workflow.description: Ground the fitness block in the sourced old-money sport canon and set the cadence estimate
workflow.gate: the old-money sport canon and the capability-vs-flex rule are stated

workflow.action: Define per-persona and duo staging rules
workflow.description: Set the scene-type alternation rule and the joint-MF reservation for evening/travel beats
workflow.gate: the alternation rule and the joint-scene reservation rule are stated

workflow.action: Compose the seasonal wheel and time-of-day grammar into the weekly calendar cadence
workflow.description: Combine the seasonal wheel, light grammar, fitness cadence and persona rule into a weekly rhythm
workflow.gate: the seasonal wheel, time-of-day grammar and weekly rhythm suggestion are composed with the never-out-of-season rule

workflow.action: Cross-check props/styling continuity across craft and evening scenes
workflow.description: Ensure watches, table settings and accessories carry the same unbranded/patina/material rules across scene blocks
workflow.gate: the shared watch/accessory/table-setting rules are restated consistently across scene blocks

workflow.action: Run the luxury-break-tells QC pass on the assembled scenario bank
workflow.description: Check every location/scene/prop choice against the gauche-tell list before handoff
workflow.gate: each item on the break-tells checklist is checked against the scenario bank and any hit is corrected before handoff

priority_rationale: The genre lock comes first because every location, scene and prop decision is tested against it; the sourced location and archetype library comes next because the scene bank is authored on top of those signatures; the scene-concept blocks (morning, craft, motion, culture, table, fitness) follow because they compose locations and archetypes into the mood|props|light units of expert work; persona/duo staging and the seasonal/time-of-day/weekly calendar composition come after because they schedule and pair the already-authored scenes; and the prop/styling crossover plus the luxury-break-tells QC checklist come last because they are the cross-cutting consistency and quality gates run over the assembled bank before handoff.

dominance_rules.rule: The quiet-luxury register dominates any single location's native loud-luxury tendency
dominance_rules.rationale: Dubai and Monaco naturally pull toward loud spectacle but the operation is genre-locked to quiet luxury
dominance_rules.trigger: a location's default imagery (skyline flash, marina/casino party) is about to be shot as-is
dominance_rules.action: restrict the location to its quiet-compatible sub-register (desert-dusk/old-town/penthouse for Dubai, corniche-and-blue-hour for Monaco)

dominance_rules.rationale: posting a location visibly out of season breaks the real-life illusion and is itself a named QC tell
dominance_rules.trigger: a shoot or post is scheduled for a location outside its sourced season window
dominance_rules.action: reschedule to the location's correct season or substitute an in-season location from the wheel

dominance_rules.rule: Patina/wabi-sabi staging dominates showroom-new prop staging
dominance_rules.rationale: too-new everything reads staged while patina reads owned, a principle sourced from the Kyoto ryokan register and generalized across the bank
dominance_rules.trigger: a prop or set is showroom-condition with zero wear
dominance_rules.action: age/patina the styling or select a location/prop that already carries it

dominance_rules.rule: Capability-and-grace framing dominates pump-and-pose flex framing in fitness-accent scenes
dominance_rules.rationale: the sourced old-money sport canon reads as heritage and restraint, not gym-bro display
dominance_rules.trigger: a fitness beat is about to be shot as an oiled-flex pose
dominance_rules.action: reframe on form-in-motion, breath and towel-off silhouette with heritage athletic wear

dominance_rules.rule: Generic archetype description dominates named-landmark specificity when trademark clearance is unresolved
dominance_rules.rationale: whether named hotels/villas/brands can be referenced is an open question deferred to the likeness/rights file
dominance_rules.trigger: a scene concept reaches for a specific trademarked property or brand name
dominance_rules.action: describe the generic unbranded archetype only until the likeness/rights file clears named use

dominance_rules.rule: Unbranded props dominate branded/logo-visible props in every scene
dominance_rules.rationale: logo spam is the defining loud-luxury marker in the sourced codes
dominance_rules.trigger: a table setting, bag or bottle with visible branding is about to enter frame
dominance_rules.action: swap for the unbranded/plain equivalent (unlabeled decanter, unbranded holdall, etc.)

dominance_rules.rule: Controlled soft/golden/blue-hour light dominates hard direct light except at the locations sourced as carrying it
dominance_rules.rationale: harsh direct light and mixed color temperatures are a named cheap-light tell
dominance_rules.trigger: a scene is about to be lit with hard direct sun outside the Amalfi-noon, yacht-deck or snow contexts
dominance_rules.action: default to the time-of-day grammar's soft/golden/blue-hour slots

dominance_rules.rule: Reserved joint MF staging dominates routine solo-persona duplication for evening/travel beats
dominance_rules.rationale: joint scenes carry higher narrative value per the micro-story cross-reference and should not be diluted
dominance_rules.trigger: a routine morning/craft beat is about to be shot as a joint MF scene
dominance_rules.action: keep morning/craft beats solo-persona and reserve joint staging for evening/travel

dominance_rules.rule: The craft-synthesis/ESTIMATE label on the scenario bank dominates presenting scene concepts as verified fact
dominance_rules.rationale: the scenario bank is craft synthesis conforming to sourced codes, not itself an independently sourced claim
dominance_rules.trigger: a scene concept is about to be cited to a stakeholder or QC as fact
dominance_rules.action: carry the craft-synthesis/ESTIMATE tag and cite only the underlying material/location codes as FACT

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lock the quiet-vs-loud genre register before authoring any location or scene content
anti_rework_rules.prevents: building a scene bank that has to be re-styled wholesale after a loud-luxury drift is discovered downstream

anti_rework_rules.rule: Fix each location's season/light window before it enters the seasonal wheel
anti_rework_rules.prevents: scheduling an out-of-season shoot that has to be pulled from the calendar and re-slotted

anti_rework_rules.rule: Define the generic-archetype-only posture for named properties/brands before any scene concept is captioned
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a caption naming a trademarked hotel or brand that must be scrubbed and re-cleared later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Set the capability-over-flex framing rule for fitness-accent scenes before any gym/pool/court beat is shot
anti_rework_rules.prevents: reshooting a fitness beat that drifted into gym-bro flex framing and broke the feed's single-world read

anti_rework_rules.rule: Establish the unbranded-props default before any table-setting or accessory prop list is built
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a prop list built around branded items that must be re-sourced or blurred in post

anti_rework_rules.rule: Confirm the time-of-day light grammar per location before shot-listing
anti_rework_rules.prevents: shooting hard direct light in a location that reads as a cheap-light tell and needing a relight or reshoot

anti_rework_rules.rule: Decide the persona-alternation and joint-scene-reservation rule before assigning scenes to M/F/MF
anti_rework_rules.prevents: over-issuing joint MF scenes to routine beats and having to rebalance the feed's narrative pacing later

anti_rework_rules.rule: Tag every scenario-bank scene concept as craft-synthesis (ESTIMATE) at authoring time
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a stakeholder treating an invented scene composition as sourced fact and having to walk back a false claim

iteration_protocol.trigger: quiet-luxury press coverage or the trend-fatigue call shifts materially
iteration_protocol.action: re-verify the genre-lock definition and adjust the quiet/loud boundary if the underlying aesthetic itself has moved

iteration_protocol.trigger: the likeness/rights research file clears or further restricts named-property/brand references
iteration_protocol.action: update the generic-archetype-only posture across all location and archetype nodes accordingly

iteration_protocol.trigger: analytics feedback shows the fitness-accent cadence or the weekly rhythm suggestion is under- or over-performing
iteration_protocol.action: retune the cadence ratio and weekly rhythm in the calendar node

iteration_protocol.trigger: a new famous-luxury location or archetype is proposed for the library
iteration_protocol.action: source its material/architecture signature and season/light window before adding it to the seasonal wheel

iteration_protocol.trigger: a realism-QC report flags a new AI-specific luxury-killer artifact not yet in the break-tells list
iteration_protocol.action: add the artifact to the break-tells list and cross-reference the realism/QC research file

iteration_protocol.trigger: the persona-alternation or joint-duo staging ratio is found to read imbalanced across the two feeds
iteration_protocol.action: re-derive the alternation and joint-scene-reservation rule from engagement data

iteration_protocol.trigger: a rare loud-luxury contrast beat is proposed
iteration_protocol.action: gate it through the weekly calendar cadence and cap its frequency before approval
